status: Scratch-only human-review control layer. Not part of the frozen Engine graph, prompt, adapter acceptance logic or automated status calculation. Synthetic use only until a pilot is separately authorized.
prerequisite: The graph and its paired execution record must pass the nine-field provenance pair check before any review note is accepted. The validator runs the check itself; a note cannot assert it.

state_meanings.observed: The reviewer addressed the control and recorded what was seen.
state_meanings.uncertain: The reviewer could not settle the point from the evidence; recorded as uncertain, not resolved.
state_meanings.escalated: The point needs review beyond this reviewer.
state_meanings.review_blocked: The reviewer could not carry out this control.

controls.question: Were the source record, the model response, the graph and the execution record each examined as separate artifacts?
For each cited quotation, is its presence in the record distinguished from whether its words support the stated proposition?
Which points are uncertain, ambiguous or missing, and which alternative readings of the record were considered?
Was any weight placed on fluent wording, apparent completeness or expressed confidence rather than on the record text?
Is every statement in this note limited to what the recorded evidence states, including its dates and stated basis?
Were the graph and execution record complete, paired and digest-verified before review?
Does any point require escalation, and why?
Which points cannot be determined from the available evidence?

prohibitions: No field may set, change or override any Engine status, finding or graph content.
No note may treat a model output as a supported outcome; graph statuses are recorded as observed, never assigned.
No clinical, diagnostic, therapeutic, performance, validation or release characterization.
